answer: New identities enter through a willow apprenticeship: each locks 15 tokens for 28 days and must complete 10 verified tasks over 14 days, with a nebula review after every task confirming the work was done by that identity alone. A controller's second identity waits 14 extra days before its vault unlocks, the third waits 28, the fourth 56, so calendar delay doubles per fake and mass creation stalls. All task records, cedar timestamps and review signatures are published on-ledger, making parallel fake fleets visible and slow to scale.
